Workflow comparison

Card AI vs Ludex: scan to collection or scan to listing?

Both products scan cards and support collections. The useful choice is what you need after the scan: confirm and track a holding, or prepare a card for sale.

DownloadApp Store Store Link PendingGoogle Play

The documented path after a scan

StepCard AILudex
ReviewConfirm a suggested catalog record, finish and languageIts scan guide says to verify card information and adjust the parallel
Price contextPublished prices and available history by raw condition or existing gradeThe guide shows an estimated price, last sold price and sales-over-time report
Next actionAdd a confirmed holding to a collectionAdd to collection or create an eBay listing

Ludex also documents sports and TCG categories. Card AI supports basketball, football and soccer; category breadth alone is not a reason to claim one product is better.

Choose based on selling plans

If you want to scan and publish an eBay listing, Ludex explicitly documents that handoff. Card AI currently offers an eBay search link for supported sports cards, not an in-app eBay listing tool. If you are sorting a stack into holdings and need raw copies and existing slabs valued separately, Card AI keeps those entries distinct in the portfolio.

Do not treat a listing ask as a sold price. Review actual transaction evidence before deciding what to charge.

How to compare the two fairly

Use the same known cards in both apps, including one base card, one parallel, and one graded slab. Record whether each result needs correction, how condition or grade is entered, and what happens after adding it to a collection. We have not run that controlled test, so this page does not claim a winner for recognition speed or accuracy.

Source: Ludex scan and price guide, reviewed October 19, 2026. Ludex plans and limits may change.

Card AI vs Ludex questions.

Is Card AI a Ludex alternative for organizing a stack?

Yes. Card AI queues up to 10 images for review and lets you add confirmed cards to a portfolio. Ludex also documents scanning and collection management; compare both on your own cards.

Can Card AI create an eBay listing like Ludex?

No. Ludex documents an eBay listing workflow. Card AI can provide an eBay search link for supported sports cards, but does not create an eBay listing.

Which scanner is more accurate?

We have not completed a controlled recognition test on the same cards in both apps, so we do not claim an accuracy winner.
